If your machine won't connect, start by checking the chip. These steps come from the Getnet FAQ:
- With the machine off, open the cover on the back. [1]
- Insert the chip in its slot, marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down. [1]
- Close the cover, turn the machine on, and wait for it to connect to the data network. [1]
- When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), the machine is ready to use. [1]
- Then run a communication test to check that the chip is connecting. [1]

Getnet also has user manuals for chip + Wi-Fi models (portable and chip-data), as well as Get Renova with and without a paper roll. [2]
